chapter: Greetings From the Knights of Favonius
act_title: Greetings From the Knights of Favonius

quests.title: Greetings From the Knights of Favonius

dialogue.t: Dragonspine can be a cold and miserable place. If you're gonna invite spectators to come and watch an event here, you gotta make it worth their while.
Hopefully, these stalls will keep people entertained and make the atmosphere in the camp more relaxed.
I'm also taking the chance to hand out some little trinkets for the teams to decorate their tents with.
Here you go — these are for The Soulblazers.
Best of luck in the competition, and don't forget to have fun!

quests.description: Amber seems to be looking for you…
